description: A small monochrome OLED display with an I2C interface. TWO different Wokwi part variants exist with DIFFERENT leg names for the same real product, confirmed via real official examples: `board-ssd1306` uses GND/VCC/SDA/SCL, `wokwi-ssd1306` (an older/simpler simulation model) uses GND/VIN/DATA/CLK.
how_to_use: Wire SDA/SCL (or DATA/CLK on the `wokwi-ssd1306` variant) to the board's real I2C pins; multiple I2C devices can share the same lines.

plain.what: A tiny, sharp screen that can show text, shapes and simple pictures.
plain.how: Four wires: GND, VCC, SCL and SDA (A4/A5 on an Uno). Use the Adafruit SSD1306 library to draw.
